numinance.kinds.v1.EvalSeeded.jsonschema.description: EvalSeeded is a defect planted in a case, by token. The defect itself is not in the set: the case stands for a recorded run on a change that has it.

caught_by.description: caught_by is required: a token naming the verifier layer expected to catch the defect; it must be among the case's expected failures.

defect.description: defect is required: a token of 1 to 64 characters naming the planted defect.
